_about: Per-BiomeDef climate envelope, EXTRACTED VERBATIM from the biome definition sheets' MEASURED blocks (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/*.md, '## 0. The measurements everything rests on'). Extracted 2026-09-09 for gen_flora_distribution_portfolio.py figF2.
_why_not_parsed: 34 sheets state temperature in 7 incompatible textual forms (canonical 'Temp p10/median/p90 A/B/C °C' on 10 sheets; parenthetical, range-only, per-region table, unlabeled-triple and absent on the rest). A regex over that set silently drops 13 sheets and mis-reads others, so the numbers are transcribed here WITH the verbatim phrase they came from — every figure number is checkable against the sheet without running anything. If a sheet's §0 is re-measured, this file is re-transcribed; it is never the place a NEW number is invented.
_fields: median/p10/p90/floor/max in °C. null = the sheet states no such figure (UNMEASURED here — never substituted, never interpolated). `form` says which textual shape the sheet used. `verbatim` is the sheet's own words.
_source_of_truth: design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/<sheet>.md — NOT _freeze_matrix.csv (which condenses the same §0 blocks into prose and loses the p10/p90 spread).

ExtremeDesert.form: per-row table in desert.md for the def as a whole; floor/max are the two sheets' own region ranges (deep desert Cracklands 27 → Kiln 43; dune sea +52 outer edge → +70 substellar)
ExtremeDesert.verbatim: `ExtremeDesert` — deep desert | 47.4° | 0.9× height | 1.0 | 48.3 °C  ·  "Deep dayside (θ ≈ 0-40°), +70 °C at the substellar point falling to about +52 °C at the outer edge"

RUT_NightsideIce.form: canonical (max stated as a bound: 'summer maximum below 0 °C on every tile')
RUT_NightsideIce.verbatim: Temp p10/median/p90 **−45.8 / −33.4 / −22 °C**, summer maximum below 0 °C on every tile

PoisonForest.form: NONE — the sheet states no biome-wide temperature (only a tail-tile donor check, '75 tiles out to 115 at −10..−3 °C', and the unreconciled 'just above freezing' claim flagged in _freeze_matrix.csv)
